notes:
### Cues and beatgrids
- **Set hot cues:** click an empty hot cue bar; right-click a hot cue to
  delete it, move it or change its colour.
- **Memory cues:** ◁ MEMORY ▷ stores, deletes and jumps between memory cues.
- **Quantize (Q):** new cues snap to the beat; hot cue jumps keep the beat.
- **Beatgrid editing (GRID):** move the grid, set the downbeat, change the
  tempo. Sync follows the edited grid.
- Edits are saved in Krate (marked **EDITED**, with an undo).
- **Sync → Cue & grid edits** lists every track you edited and shows what
  each would change in Engine DJ (or that it's up to date). Tick the tracks
  you want and save their hot cues and grids into your Engine library or an
  Engine USB drive, backed up first. The deck's **EDITED** menu takes you
  there.
- **Save to Rekordbox:** the same screen saves hot cues and memory cues into
  Rekordbox's library, backed up first (Rekordbox must be closed).
  Beatgrids follow in a later version. Cue colours other than green and
  orange are saved as Rekordbox's default green for now.

### Libraries
- New **Format** column in the track list (MP3, AIFF, WAV, …), plus
  **Bitrate** and **Label** columns you can turn on.
- Right-click the column headers to show or hide columns.
- The "… tracks" bar under the track list is gone (the sidebar shows the
  counts), leaving more room for tracks.
- When Krate starts, it looks for DJ libraries on this computer that
  aren't in Krate yet and offers to add them in a banner. **Not now** asks
  again next time; **Don't ask again** stops it for those libraries
  (undo in Settings → General).
- Imported libraries also update when you switch back to Krate's window,
  so changes made in Rekordbox or Engine DJ meanwhile show up.

### Fixes
- Tidy no longer overwrites edits made in Rekordbox or Engine DJ after its
  preview: such changes are left out and listed.
- On macOS Tahoe, the player's waveforms could fail to show, with the track
  overview filling the whole player. Fixed.
- The waveform colours chosen in Settings (Tri-band, RGB) now apply from
  the start, not only after visiting Settings.
- If the audio output doesn't start or stops, the player now says so
  (instead of showing "– BPM" and a frozen deck).

### Other
- The waveform colours moved to Settings → Player & mixer.
- Tidy's tabs have clearer names: **Health** (the text fixes) is now
  **Smart fixes**, and **Files** (the file checks) is now **Health**.
- **What's new** never pops up by itself any more: the update banner has a
  **See what's new** link, and after updating a small banner says so, with
  the same link. The notes link to the release on GitHub.
- The track list is a little more compact by default (24 px per track;
  adjust it in Settings → Appearance → Track list size).
- The sidebar keeps its open folders when you hide it or switch to another
  screen and back.
- After a library is re-imported (for example after Tidy), the sidebar
  shows its current playlists instead of the old ones.
